relation_to_r2: Isotropic latent columns use the same centering, training-scale, and unit spectrum construction as R2. The network sees only the first input_columns of that design. The linear tolerance 1e-8 is not reused.
sigma_rule: sigma = 1/sqrt(snr) from the unit teacher norm.
architecture: One ReLU hidden layer and a linear output. Hidden weights use scale sqrt(2/input_columns); output weights use scale sqrt(1/width). Bias starts at zero. No dropout.
optimizer: Full-batch Adam, learning rate 0.01, on CPU. until_residual stops at the first epoch whose relative training residual is <= 0.001, or at epoch 500. epochs_40 always runs 40 epochs.
interpolation_rule: A cell interpolates only when its final relative training residual, the L2 norm of prediction minus training response divided by the L2 norm of the training response, is <= 0.001. Positive weight decay is not required to interpolate. A width bracket requires one narrower width above the tolerance and one wider width at or below it.
contrast_rule: Noise and budget contrasts use the mean paired clean-risk difference. A positive mean supports the named direction only when it is at least 0.01 and greater than its across-draw standard error, on at least 5 bracketed draws. A nonpositive mean refutes that direction. Otherwise the contrast is inconclusive. These are not confidence intervals. No peak is required.

primary_contrasts.noise: until_residual, weight decay 0, mean clean risk at the predeclared widths, SNR 1 minus SNR 5
primary_contrasts.budget: weight decay 0, SNR 1, clean risk of epochs_40 minus until_residual at the same widths
primary_contrasts.weight_decay: width 64, SNR 1, until_residual, weight decay 0 minus weight decay 0.001
